modules.title: 把沙發放在客廳吧。
modules.title_py: Bǎ shā fā fàng zài kè tīng ba.
modules.title_id: Just put the sofa in the living room.
modules.scene: Moving day at a two-storey house with a yard. Dawen and Zhiming arrange the furniture, and then Meimei comes to visit.
can_do: Put something somewhere: 把 O 放在 + place
Move something to a place: 把 O 搬到 + place + 去/來
Describe a house: 層、臥室、院子、座
modules.exam_link: Arranging a room (把…放在…) is material for 聽力 Part 1 (pictures of where things are) and 聽力 Part 3 (moving instructions).

lines.zh: 志明，我們把沙發放在客廳吧。
lines.py: Zhì míng, wǒ men bǎ shā fā fàng zài kè tīng ba.
lines.id: Zhiming, let's put the sofa in the living room.

lines.zh: 好。這個櫃子呢？
lines.py: Hǎo. Zhè ge guì zi ne?
lines.id: OK. What about this cupboard?

lines.zh: 把櫃子搬到臥室去。
lines.py: Bǎ guì zi bān dào wò shì qù.
lines.id: Carry the cupboard to the bedroom.

lines.zh: 臥室在二樓，太重了！我們先把它放在樓下的房間吧。
lines.py: Wò shì zài èr lóu, tài zhòng le! Wǒ men xiān bǎ tā fàng zài lóu xià de fáng jiān ba.
lines.id: The bedroom's on the first floor — it's too heavy! Put it in the room downstairs for now.

lines.zh: 大文，你的新房子有院子嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ de xīn fáng zi yǒu yuàn zi ma?
lines.id: Dawen, does your new house have a yard?

lines.zh: 有，房子有兩層，院子很大。
lines.py: Yǒu, fáng zi yǒu liǎng céng, yuàn zi hěn dà.
lines.id: Yes, the house has two floors and the yard is big.

lines.zh: 這座房子很漂亮！這個廳也很大。
lines.py: Zhè zuò fáng zi hěn piào liang! Zhè ge tīng yě hěn dà.
lines.id: This house is beautiful! The hall's big too.

lines.zh: 你的包別放在椅子底下，把它放到桌子上來吧。
lines.py: Nǐ de bāo bié fàng zài yǐ zi dǐ xià, bǎ tā fàng dào zhuō zi shàng lái ba.
lines.id: Don't leave your bag under the chair — put it on the table.

tasks.question: 他把書放在哪裡？
tasks.why: The book is put on the table → 桌子上. B and C are other places.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a floor plan: three bedrooms

tasks.question: 你們家有幾個臥室？
tasks.why: The floor plan shows three bedrooms → 三個. A is the wrong number; C gives the number of floors.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a puppy playing in the yard

tasks.question: 小狗在哪裡玩？
tasks.why: The puppy is playing in the yard → 院子裡. A and B are inside the house.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: The question asks for a place → 搬到臥室去. A comments on the weight; C does not answer.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
options: 有，院子不大，可是很漂亮。
tasks.why: The question is whether there is a yard → 有. B and C talk about other things in the house.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.

lines.zh: 我們把沙發放在客廳吧。
客廳太小了，放在樓上的房間怎麼樣？
沙發太重了，搬不上去。
那好吧，就放在客廳。

tasks.question: 他們要把沙發放在哪裡？
tasks.why: In the end 就放在客廳. A is her suggestion, dropped because it is too heavy. C is not mentioned.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 這個櫃子要放在哪裡？
放在臥室吧。
臥室在二樓，我們兩個人搬得上去嗎？
那放在樓下吧，爸爸回來以後再搬。

tasks.question: 這位小姐是什麼意思？
tasks.why: 我們兩個人搬得上去嗎？ = doubts they can carry it up → the cabinet is too heavy. A, B and C are not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 請把這張桌子搬到院子裡去。

options.label: carrying a table into the yard

tasks.why: 搬到院子裡去 = moved into the yard. A and C are other places.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.

picture.label: a cat under a chair

tasks.why: The cat is under the chair → 底下. A is the opposite (on top); B is another place.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.

picture.label: tall buildings

tasks.text: 這（　）大樓有二十層。
tasks.why: The measure word for buildings is 座. 張 is for flat things; 件 for clothes or matters.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 上個星期我們搬家了。新房子有兩（1），樓上是臥室，樓下是客廳。搬家那天，爸爸說：「先把沙發（2）。」我跟哥哥一起把書桌（3），因為臥室在樓上。妹妹的小狗很怕人，一直在（4）。媽媽把花（5），她說花在外面比較好看。
tasks.why: (1) 兩層 = two floors. (2) the sofa goes in the living room. (3) the desk goes upstairs because the bedrooms are upstairs. (4) the dog hides under a chair. (5) flowers in the yard. 「有三座」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 我們的新房子有兩層。樓下有客廳和廚房，樓上有三個臥室。房子旁邊還有一個院子，有很多花。媽媽不太喜歡，因為院子太大，每天都要用很多時間；可是弟弟很高興，因為他可以在院子裡跟小狗玩。
tasks.question: 哪一個是對的？
tasks.why: 樓上有三個臥室 → all the bedrooms are upstairs. A: the kitchen is downstairs. B: the house has two floors. D is the opposite (弟弟很高興).

grammar.point: 把 O V在 + place — put … at …
grammar.pattern: S + 把 + O + V + 在 + place
grammar.explain: To say a thing is MOVED/PUT somewhere, Mandarin uses 把: 把沙發放在客廳 (not 放沙發在客廳 ✗).

examples.zh: 我們把沙發放在客廳吧。
examples.id: Let's put the sofa in the living room.

grammar.point: 把 O V到 + place + 來/去 — move … to …
grammar.pattern: S + 把 + O + V + 到 + place + (來/去)
grammar.explain: V到 + place = arrive at the destination; 來/去 shows the direction relative to the speaker: 把櫃子搬到臥室去 (carry it to the bedroom, away), 把它放到桌子上來 (put it on the table here).

examples.id: Carry the cupboard to the bedroom.

options: 把那張椅子拿到這裡來。
拿到這裡來把那張椅子。
把那張椅子到這裡拿來。

modules.title: 我今天必須加班。
modules.title_py: Wǒ jīn tiān bì xū jiā bān.
modules.title_id: I have to work overtime today.
modules.scene: Dawen, an intern, has to work overtime to finish a report for a meeting; the next day his boss praises him and lets him off overtime.
can_do: Express strong obligation with 必須
Say 'no need' with 不用／不必
Talk about office work: 加班、開會、報告、要求
modules.exam_link: Office communication (meetings, reports, overtime) SOMETIMES appears in 聽力 Parts 3–4. 必須 vs 不必 is often the key to rule questions in 閱讀 Part 3.

lines.zh: 大文，今天晚上一起吃飯吧！
lines.py: Dà wén, jīn tiān wǎn shang yì qǐ chī fàn ba!
lines.id: Dawen, let's have dinner together tonight!

lines.zh: 對不起，我今天必須加班。
lines.py: Duì bù qǐ, wǒ jīn tiān bì xū jiā bān.
lines.id: Sorry, I have to work overtime today.

lines.zh: 為什麼？
lines.py: Wèi shén me?
lines.id: Why?

lines.zh: 明天要開會，我必須寫完報告。
lines.py: Míng tiān yào kāi huì, wǒ bì xū xiě wán bào gào.
lines.id: There's a meeting tomorrow — I have to finish a report.

dialogs.title_id: The next day, at the office

lines.zh: 大文，你的報告寫得很好。今天你不用加班了。
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ de bào gào xiě de hěn hǎo. Jīn tiān nǐ bú yòng jiā bān le.
lines.id: Dawen, your report is good. You don't need to work overtime today.

lines.zh: 太好了！明天還要開會嗎？
lines.py: Tài hǎo le! Míng tiān hái yào kāi huì ma?
lines.id: Great! Is there still a meeting tomorrow?

lines.zh: 不必。公司的要求，你都做得很好。
lines.py: Bú bì. Gōng sī de yāo qiú, nǐ dōu zuò de hěn hǎo.
lines.id: No need. You've done everything the company asked for well.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a meeting in an office with charts

tasks.question: 他們在做什麼？
tasks.why: An office meeting room with a chart → 開會. A and C are other activities.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: in the evening he is still working at the office

tasks.question: 你今天晚上要做什麼？
tasks.why: Still working in the office at night → 必須加班. A and C do not match the picture.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: 3 o'clock, people gathering for a meeting

tasks.question: 你們幾點開會？
tasks.why: The clock shows 3 → 三點. A is the wrong time; B adds half an hour.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: The question is whether he must work late → 不用. A is a general comment; C does not answer.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: The question is whether it is necessary → 不必. B gives a location; C talks about himself.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.

lines.zh: 明天的會幾點開始？
九點。不對，王先生說十點。
我要帶報告嗎？
不用，王先生已經有了。

tasks.question: 明天的會幾點開始？
tasks.why: 不對，王先生說十點 → 10 o'clock. A is corrected by the speaker himself; C is not mentioned.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 王先生說明天的會不開了。
真的嗎？那我今天不必寫報告了？
報告還是要寫，下星期一必須交。
好吧，那我週末再寫。

tasks.question: 這位小姐的意思是什麼？
tasks.why: 週末再寫 → she will not write the report today. B is the opposite. C: she will still write it. D: it has not been written.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 晚上十點了，他還在公司寫報告。

options.label: at the office in the daytime
at the office at night writing a report
at home at night watching TV

tasks.why: 晚上十點 + 在公司寫報告. A is the wrong time; C the wrong place.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.

picture.label: writing a report

tasks.why: Writing on paper → 寫報告. B and C are other activities.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.

picture.label: relaxing at home, no need to go to work

tasks.text: 明天是星期天，你（　）來公司。
tasks.why: Sunday + relaxing at home → 不用 (no need). 必須 is the opposite; 要求 = demand (it needs a person as object).

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我在一家公司上班。最近公司很忙，我每天都（1），晚上十點才回家。上個星期，老闆（2）大家星期五以前必須寫完報告。我的報告寫了三天才寫完。星期五早上（3）的時候，老闆說我的報告寫得很好，他說：「這個週末你（4）。」我很高興，因為我（5）好好休息一下。
tasks.why: (1) working late every day. (2) the boss requires it. (3) during the meeting. (4) no need to come in at the weekend. (5) 必須好好休息 = really needs a good rest. 「很想打工」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read these office rules, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 大文：明天早上九點要開會，我不能去，請你替我開會。開會的報告我已經寫好了，放在你的桌子上。開會以前你不必再看一次，可是老闆要求大家十點以前必須交報告，請你開完會就交給他。謝謝！——小林
tasks.question: 大文明天要做什麼？
options: 替小林開會，然後交報告
tasks.why: 請你替我開會 + 開完會就交給他. A: 小林 has already written the report. B: the meeting is at 9; 10 is the deadline for the report. D is not mentioned.

grammar.explain: 必須 = must, have to (stronger and more formal than 要). Its negative is NOT 不必須 but 不用 or 不必.

examples.id: I have to work overtime today.
I have to finish the report.

grammar.explain: 不用 (spoken) and 不必 (a little formal) = there's no need. Also used as short answers: 不必。／不用了。

examples.id: You don't need to work overtime today.

check.q: The 'no need' answer to 我必須帶書嗎？

pendukung.meaning: to finish, to be over (吃完, 寫完)

modules.title: 要是颱風來了，就不去溫泉了。
modules.title_py: Yào shì tái fēng lái le, jiù bú qù wēn quán le.
modules.title_id: If the typhoon comes, we won't go to the hot spring.
modules.scene: Meimei suggests going to a hot spring in Beitou, but the news forecasts a typhoon. They make a conditional plan.
can_do: Understand weather news: 颱風、中心、方向、度
Talk about locations & estimates: 地點、大概
modules.exam_link: Typhoon news & conditional plans are a typically Taiwanese context in 聽力 Part 4 and 閱讀 Part 5.

lines.zh: 大文，週末我們去溫泉吧！
lines.py: Dà wén, zhōu mò wǒ men qù wēn quán ba!
lines.id: Dawen, let's go to a hot spring this weekend!

lines.zh: 新聞說颱風要來了。
lines.py: Xīn wén shuō tái fēng yào lái le.
lines.id: The news says a typhoon is coming.

lines.zh: 要是颱風來了，就不去溫泉了。
lines.py: Yào shì tái fēng lái le, jiù bú qù wēn quán le.
lines.id: If the typhoon comes, we won't go to the hot spring.

lines.zh: 颱風的中心在哪裡？
lines.py: Tái fēng de zhōng xīn zài nǎ lǐ?
lines.id: Where's the centre of the typhoon?

lines.zh: 在臺灣的南方，方向是往北。
lines.py: Zài Tái wān de nán fāng, fāng xiàng shì wǎng běi.
lines.id: South of Taiwan, heading north.

lines.zh: 溫泉的地點在哪裡？
lines.py: Wēn quán de dì diǎn zài nǎ lǐ?
lines.id: Where's the hot spring?

lines.zh: 在北投。春季去溫泉最好。現在二十度，不冷也不熱。
lines.py: Zài Běi tóu. Chūn jì qù wēn quán zuì hǎo. Xiàn zài èr shí dù, bù lěng yě bú rè.
lines.id: In Beitou. Spring is the best time to go to a hot spring. It's 20 degrees now — not cold, not hot.

lines.zh: 下雨的話，我們大概就不去了。
lines.py: Xià yǔ de huà, wǒ men dà gài jiù bú qù le.
lines.id: If it rains, we might not go.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a typhoon: strong wind, bending trees, rain

tasks.question: 天氣怎麼樣？
tasks.why: Strong wind, bent trees, rain → 颱風. A and C are calm weather.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: typhoon clouds spiralling closer

tasks.question: 天氣怎麼樣？
tasks.why: A typhoon swirl is approaching → 要來了. A: there is typhoon wind. B: the typhoon has not passed yet.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: people soaking in a steaming hot spring

tasks.question: 你們去哪裡？
tasks.why: A steaming pool → 溫泉. A and C are other places.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.audio: 要是明天下雨，我們還去溫泉嗎？
options: 下雨的話，就下個星期去吧。
tasks.why: A conditional question → a conditional answer (的話). B gives the place; C does not answer.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.why: 地點 = location → 在北投. B is an opinion; C says when.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then answer the question.

lines.zh: 我們春季去溫泉，好不好？
春季的話，天氣大概二十度，很舒服。
那我們三月去。
好，要是有時間，我們也去爬山。

tasks.question: 他們什麼時候去溫泉？
tasks.why: 那我們三月去 (spring). A and B are not mentioned.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 聽說颱風要來了，我們的旅行怎麼辦？
要是颱風來了，飛機就不飛了。
那我們坐火車去，好不好？
颱風的話，火車也可能不開。還是等颱風走了再去吧。

tasks.question: 這位小姐覺得應該怎麼做？
tasks.why: 等颱風走了再去 → postponed, not cancelled. A and B are ruled out (they won't run in a typhoon). C goes too far: she only postpones.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 要是颱風來了，我們就在家看電視。
tasks.why: 颱風來了 + 在家看電視. A has no typhoon; C is outside.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.

picture.label: a hot spring

tasks.why: The hot-spring symbol → 溫泉. A and B do not match.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.

picture.label: 20 degrees

tasks.text: 今天的天氣大概二十（　），不冷也不熱。
tasks.why: Temperature → 度. 點 is for clock time; 號 for dates.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我們想週末去北投的溫泉。可是新聞說有（1）要來，（2）是往北。媽媽說：「颱風來了的話，我們（3）不去了。」我問：「那我們什麼時候去？」媽媽說：「等（4）吧，那時候天氣大概二十（5），最舒服。」
tasks.why: (1) a typhoon is coming. (2) heading north. (3) …的話，就… (4) wait until spring. (5) 二十度 = 20 degrees. 「溫泉」 fits no blank.

tasks.instr: Read this news report, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 新聞說，颱風的中心現在在臺灣的南方，方向是往北，大概明天晚上會到台北。要是颱風來了，學校和公司都不上課、不上班。所以媽媽今天就去超市買了很多東西，她說颱風來的話，就不能出門了。
tasks.question: 媽媽為什麼今天去超市買很多東西？
options: 颱風來的話，就不能出門了
tasks.why: 颱風來的話，就不能出門了 → that is the reason. A is not mentioned. C is true but not why she shopped. D: the typhoon is in the south; she is not going there.

grammar.explain: 要是 = if (more colloquial than 如果, B18). 就 marks the result in the second clause.

examples.zh: 要是颱風來了，就不去溫泉了。
examples.id: If the typhoon comes, we won't go to the hot spring.

options: 要是你有空，我們就去看電影。
你要是有空就，我們去看電影。
就要是你有空，我們去看電影。

grammar.explain: 的話 goes at the END of the condition: 下雨的話 = if it rains. It can be combined with 要是/如果: 要是下雨的話.

examples.zh: 下雨的話，我們大概就不去了。
examples.id: If it rains, we might not go.

modules.title: 我的藥被弟弟吃掉了！
modules.title_py: Wǒ de yào bèi dì di chī diào le!
modules.title_id: My little brother ate all my medicine!
modules.scene: Dawen comes down with a bad flu in the dorm; on the phone, Meimei has the flu too, and her little brother ate her medicine, thinking it was sweets.
can_do: Describe symptoms: 發燒、咳嗽、流鼻水、頭痛、流汗
Express an effect suffered with 被…V得… (被感冒弄得很累)
modules.exam_link: Symptoms are a FREQUENT topic in 聽力 Part 4 and 閱讀 Parts 1 & 4; questions often ask you to pick the symptom that is NOT mentioned.

lines.zh: 大文，你怎麼了？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ zěn me le?
lines.id: Dawen, what's wrong?

lines.zh: 我發燒了，也一直咳嗽。
lines.py: Wǒ fā shāo le, yě yì zhí ké sòu.
lines.id: I've got a fever, and I keep coughing.

tasks.text: 昨天下午我去打籃球，打了兩個小時，（1），衣服都溼了。晚上我開始（2），一直咳嗽，也（3）。今天早上我去看醫生，醫生說不太（4），多喝水、多休息就好了。我桌上的麵包（5），我只好喝牛奶。
tasks.why: (1) sweated a lot. (2) started running a fever. (3) runny nose. (4) not very serious. (5) 被…吃掉了 = eaten by his roommate. 「頭痛得很好」 makes no sense.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 上個星期弟弟感冒了，後來我也感冒了。我一直咳嗽、流鼻水，晚上也常常頭痛。醫生給了我一些藥，說一天吃三次。可是第三天我找不到藥了，問了媽媽才知道，是被弟弟吃掉了，他以為那是他的藥。媽媽只好再帶我去看醫生。
tasks.question: 為什麼媽媽又帶他去看醫生？
tasks.why: 藥被弟弟吃掉了 → the medicine was gone. A is not mentioned. C is true, but not why he went back to the doctor. D is not mentioned.

grammar.point: 被 + (N) + V得 + effect — made … by …
grammar.pattern: S + 被 + N + V + 得 + effect
grammar.explain: The passive pattern with 得 stresses the EFFECT on the subject: 我被這個感冒弄得很累 (this flu has worn me out).

examples.zh: 我被這個感冒弄得很累。
examples.id: This flu has really worn me out.

grammar.explain: 掉 after a verb = something is used up/thrown away/lost through that action: 吃掉 (eaten up), 丟掉 (thrown away), 用掉 (used up).

examples.id: My little brother ate all my medicine!

modules.title: 打八折！一件比一件便宜。
modules.title_py: Dǎ bā zhé! Yí jiàn bǐ yí jiàn pián yí.
modules.scene: The department store is having a big sale. Dawen and Meimei join the queue, compare prices and judge the sizes of clothes.
can_do: Make successive comparisons: 一件比一件…
Say 'a bit too …': Vs了一點 (貴了一點)
modules.exam_link: Taiwanese-style discounts (打X折 = pay X0%) are a classic trap for learners in 聽力 Part 3 and 閱讀 Part 3.

lines.zh: 大文，百貨公司今天打八折！

lines.zh: 這件外套打八折，還是貴了一點。
lines.py: Zhè jiàn wài tào dǎ bā zhé, hái shì guì le yì diǎn.

tasks.text: 今天百貨公司有很多東西（1），所以人很多，很（2）。我跟朋友一起去（3）。很多人在門口（4）。我看到一件外套，很漂亮，可是（5），所以我沒買。

tasks.instr: Read this sale board, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 週末的百貨公司很熱鬧，因為有很多東西打折。我跟媽媽去逛街，一樓的衣服打八折，二樓打七折，三樓打五折，一層比一層便宜。我們在三樓等了半個小時才買到。可是回家以後，我發現那件外套大了一點。
tasks.question: 他們為什麼去三樓買？
tasks.why: 三樓打五折 — the cheapest (一層比一層便宜). A: they actually waited half an hour. B is not mentioned. D is not given as the reason.

grammar.point: 一 M 比一 M — more and more …
grammar.pattern: 一 + M + 比 + 一 + M + Vs
grammar.explain: Comparing one after another so that it feels like it's increasing: 一件比一件便宜 (each one cheaper than the last), 一天比一天冷 (colder day by day).

examples.zh: 這裡的衣服一件比一件便宜！
examples.id: The clothes here get cheaper and cheaper!

grammar.explain: Vs了一點 = a little more than you'd like (a mild complaint): 貴了一點 (a bit too expensive), 大了一點 (a bit too big). Compare 有點貴 (B20) and 貴一點 (B21, asking for a more … one).

examples.id: It's discounted, but still a bit too expensive.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 今天是我的生日，（1）朋友們給我辦了一個派對。他們（2）準備了蛋糕，（3）還送了我一個禮物。我的（4）好得不得了。派對以後，我覺得很（5）。
tasks.why: (1) unexpectedly. (2)(3) 不但…而且… (4) mood. (5) relaxed. 「擔心」 contradicts the happy mood.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 上個週末我去朋友家。我以為只是一起吃飯，沒想到一開門，大家都說：「生日快樂！」我才知道他們給我辦了一個生日派對。他們不但準備了蛋糕，而且還唱歌給我聽。那天我的心情好得不得了，覺得很輕鬆，也很開心。
tasks.question: 這個人去朋友家以前，以為要做什麼？
tasks.why: 我以為只是一起吃飯. A is what actually happened (沒想到). B and D are part of the party.

grammar.point: 不但…而且… — not only …, but even …
grammar.pattern: S + 不但 + A，而且 + (還) + B
grammar.explain: A stronger form than 不但…還…: 而且 introduces a second, more surprising point. 還 can be added after 而且.

examples.zh: 你不但來了，而且還帶了禮物！
examples.id: You didn't just come — you brought a present too!

check.q: 'This cake is not only cheap, but tasty too' =
options: 這個蛋糕不但便宜，而且好吃。
這個蛋糕而且便宜，不但好吃。
不但這個蛋糕便宜好吃而且。

grammar.explain: 而且 adds information in the same direction (both positive or both negative): 很輕鬆，而且很高興. It can be used without 不但.

check.q: Choose the right word: 這家店很便宜，＿＿東西很好。
